how_to_notes.heading: Introduction
how_to_notes.purpose: State what Chapter III plans and what it must not claim.
how_to_notes.do: Keep the chapter as Capella operations-cluster prose. Name GQI, CIT, hybrid codebook TA, and Delve as CAQDAS only.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not name Chapter IV themes, write 'lived experience,' or say data will be analyzed using Delve.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Topic/Problem and Gap restatement without findings.

how_to_notes.heading: Research Design
how_to_notes.purpose: Declare GQI + CIT with a sensitizing, not confirmatory, framework.
how_to_notes.do: Keep unit of analysis as one U.S. SME manager recounting one qualifying ITDRPaaS incident in 36 months.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not convert the design into phenomenology, an audit, or a confirmatory test of Mitchell et al. (1997).
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Methodology* for GQI language and absence of essence claims.

how_to_notes.heading: Generic qualitative inquiry
how_to_notes.purpose: Justify GQI as accounts of external events, decisions, and artifacts.
how_to_notes.do: Permit theoretically informed items only if they stay in manager language and constructs are not treated as conclusions.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not use lived experience, essence, or voices as analytic claims.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Methodology* against Capella GQI (not phenomenology).

how_to_notes.heading: Critical-incident interview stance
how_to_notes.purpose: Bind talk to one named disruption, failover, test, or operational recovery.
how_to_notes.do: Use CIT because the gap is operational: competing claims when restoration is ranked, delayed, or declared done.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not treat Guest et al. (2006) as the interview method.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks that Data Collection stays incident-bound.

how_to_notes.heading: Framework role: sensitizing, not confirmatory
how_to_notes.purpose: Place PLU and enactment constructs on Constructs, not as pre-named themes.
how_to_notes.do: Cite Mitchell et al. (1997) as original; later work as build-on. Keep leverage as enacted combination, not a fourth attribute.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not pre-write Chapter IV themes from the seven labels.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Constructs are sensitizing probes, not a priori findings.

how_to_notes.heading: Alignment spine
how_to_notes.purpose: Keep the planned chain intact from Problem through Chapter V interpretation.
how_to_notes.do: Use the spine table as the alignment tester for every later header. Empty Theme/Finding cells until Chapter IV.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not claim SAL → DR → ESC → AE as a proven substantive theory.

how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester walks Problem → Purpose → PQs → Framework → sources → items → collection → codes → categories → themes.

how_to_notes.heading: Population and Sampling
how_to_notes.purpose: Name who can close the Gap and how they are selected.
how_to_notes.do: Keep U.S. SME IT/network/systems/infrastructure/operations managers on external recovery platforms.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not recruit vendor-only staff or executives with no operational recovery role.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Population* and Sample* against inclusion and information power.

how_to_notes.heading: Population
how_to_notes.purpose: Bound the population at U.S. SMEs (10–200 personnel) with a named ITDRPaaS incident in 36 months.
how_to_notes.do: Require a direct operational recovery role on an external platform or managed recovery service.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not include vendor staff whose only role is operating the platform for clients.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Population* matches the Gap (SME managers, not large-enterprise command).

how_to_notes.heading: Sampling strategy
how_to_notes.purpose: Justify n = 10–15 with information power, not automatic saturation.
how_to_notes.do: Use purposive/criterion sampling. Stopping is an analytic decision from the codebook and meaning-unit inventory.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not use Guest et al. (2006) to justify CIT, sample size in advance, or a claim that 12 interviews suffice.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Sample* for information power (Malterud et al., 2016).

how_to_notes.heading: Recruitment
how_to_notes.purpose: Protect PQ2 data quality by recruiting individually, not through a supervisor chain.
how_to_notes.do: Screen inclusion, email consent, then schedule 60–75 minutes. Assign P## before the call.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not continue an interview from a generic 'how we usually recover' account.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Recruitment* channel, length, and consent sequence.

how_to_notes.heading: Instrumentation
how_to_notes.purpose: Name the primary interview guide and the secondary artifact review.
how_to_notes.do: Keep theoretical labels in the codebook. Spoken questions use manager language.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not treat the unpublished instrument as a theory source.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Measures/Artifacts have collectable items for each construct.

how_to_notes.heading: Primary instrument
how_to_notes.purpose: Run ITDR-GQI-INT-v0.1.1: ethics, Q0, Set L, Sets A–F, Q-close, skip-if-covered, boundary cases.
how_to_notes.do: Skip a set only when a concrete example already exists. Boundary cases are valid data.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not introduce power, legitimacy, urgency, or proof in Q0.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks each Gap construct has a collectable item or skip-plus-boundary.

how_to_notes.heading: Researcher-only leverage diagnostic
how_to_notes.purpose: Complete one leverage-memo row after the session; never read it to the participant.
how_to_notes.do: Map attribute_mix to Mitchell type names as memo values only.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not import Mitchell type names into Delve as theme titles or Chapter IV headings. Leverage is not a fourth salience attribute.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Constructs vs Data Analysis: memo labels are not findings.

how_to_notes.heading: Secondary instrument: artifacts as context
how_to_notes.purpose: Review objects the manager names in the incident via Path A (redacted share), B (verbal reconstruction), or C (none named).
how_to_notes.do: File Path A as P##_ART##. Recode empty Path A after 14 days as Path B. Path C is a recoverability-assurance boundary.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not score artifacts against NIST/ISO/BCM. Do not invent contents the participant did not state. Refusal to share does not end the interview.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Measures/Artifacts have an obtain / refuse / de-identify / map rule.

how_to_notes.heading: Data Collection
how_to_notes.purpose: Execute one recorded 60–75 minute video interview plus artifact intake.
how_to_notes.do: Confirm consent and inclusion; read the ethics script; keep probes inside the named event; stop if the recorder fails.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not offer forced choices or continue from memory. Completeness is a collection standard, not a finding.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Data Collection* has written steps, not only named instruments.

how_to_notes.heading: Data Preparation and Management
how_to_notes.purpose: Move RAW → CLEAN → ANALYTIC, with dated CSV nest backups.
how_to_notes.do: Import only CLEAN transcripts to Delve. Member-check CLEAN facts, not ANALYTIC theme names.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not put RAW identifiers in the public nest. Participants may not delete a de-identified contested decision.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Dependability* for a retraceable audit trail.

how_to_notes.heading: Qualitative Data Analysis
how_to_notes.purpose: Name hybrid codebook TA as the method; keep Theme/Finding cells empty.
how_to_notes.do: Lock meaning units before theme names. Import STRUCTURAL, FRAMEWORK_DEDUCTIVE, and BOUNDARY; leave EMERGENT empty at first code.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not write that data will be analyzed using Delve, or that themes emerged.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Data Analysis stays a reduction method, not pre-named themes.

how_to_notes.heading: Declaration of method
how_to_notes.purpose: Declare hybrid deductive–inductive codebook thematic analysis (Fereday & Muir-Cochrane, 2006).
how_to_notes.do: Cite Braun and Clarke for quality of thematic practice only. Default trustworthiness is audit trail, not kappa.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not mix ICR with a claim that the study is doing reflexive TA.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Data Analysis names a method that can map PQ1/PQ2 onto a versioned codebook.

how_to_notes.heading: Why this method and not the adjacent alternatives
how_to_notes.purpose: Reject reflexive TA as method, purely inductive TA, confirmatory Mitchell coding, NIST scoring, and Delve-as-method.
how_to_notes.do: Keep the adjacent-choice table in the chapter when reviewers ask 'why not NVivo/RTA/content analysis.'
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not treat CAQDAS as the analytic method.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Methodology and Data Analysis do not drift into audit or phenomenology.

how_to_notes.heading: Analytic steps (adapted hybrid codebook TA)
how_to_notes.purpose: Follow the written hybrid steps: lock meaning units, apply template codes, add EMERGENT after lock, group, then name themes in Chapter IV.
how_to_notes.do: Require a named excerpt and a boundary/negative case before promoting a unit.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not name themes in Chapter III. Frequency is not importance.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Practice 2 lock-before-name is still the reduction rule.

how_to_notes.heading: Delve nested start-list (import; do not treat as themes)
how_to_notes.purpose: Import the nested start-list as filing and sensitizing devices.
how_to_notes.do: Keep STRUCTURAL / FRAMEWORK_DEDUCTIVE / BOUNDARY names identical to docs/notion/templates/codebook.csv.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not treat imported codes as Chapter IV headings.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Constructs inform Measures; they do not pre-write Data Analysis themes.

how_to_notes.heading: Planned-analysis matrix
how_to_notes.purpose: Map every question ID to PQ, structural code, and planned framework/boundary codes.
how_to_notes.do: Leave Category / Theme / Finding columns empty. Official RQ labels replace PQ1/PQ2 in Maps-to without changing question IDs.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not require every ID to be asked aloud; skipped rows still map.
how_to_notes.spine_check: Instrument questions; Codes; Questions; Themes_ChIV; Findings_ChIV
how_to_notes.tester_check: Questions tester stays Partial until official RQ wording is locked.

how_to_notes.heading: Ten control rules
how_to_notes.purpose: Govern coding, memoing, and write-up. A violation is a dependability incident logged the same day.
how_to_notes.do: Method first, software second. Codes are not themes. Themes are claims. Do not write that themes emerged.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not treat leverage as a fourth salience attribute or NIST/ISO/BCM as a coding system.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Dependability* has enforceable write-up rules.

how_to_notes.heading: Chapter III versus Chapter IV versus Chapter V
how_to_notes.purpose: Keep the chapter split: III plans, IV reports, V interprets.
how_to_notes.do: Do not offer implications in III or IV. Do not newly name themes in V.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not treat Delve or the CSV nest as a contribution.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks the spine end-nodes stay empty in this chapter.

how_to_notes.heading: Optional: committee-required second coder and ICR
how_to_notes.purpose: Keep ICR optional and off by default for this single-researcher dissertation.
how_to_notes.do: Activate only if the committee requires a second coder. Do not mix ICR with reflexive TA.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not make kappa a default quality claim.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Dependability does not require multiple coders as a GQI condition.

how_to_notes.heading: Trustworthiness
how_to_notes.purpose: Use credibility, dependability, confirmability, and transferability (Lincoln & Guba, 1985).
how_to_notes.do: Keep member check factual-only. Treat saturation as a decision guide, not a badge that n = 10–15 earns.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not claim 10–15 U.S. SME managers represent all ITDRPaaS settings.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Dependability* for a visible audit trail and threat mitigations.

how_to_notes.heading: Ethical Protections
how_to_notes.purpose: Submit to Capella IRB before recruitment; treat organizational risk as a Gap-data threat.
how_to_notes.do: Optional artifacts, factual member check, encrypted RAW storage, pause/skip/stop for distress.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not put RAW identifiers in courseroom appendices or the public CSV nest.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks Procedures* protect contested authority and failed-proof talk.

how_to_notes.heading: Chapter Summary
how_to_notes.purpose: Restate the planned chain without converting it into findings.
how_to_notes.do: Repeat GQI, CIT, U.S. SME sample, instrument ID, hybrid codebook TA, and the III/IV/V split.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not sneak theme titles into the summary.
how_to_notes.spine_check: Problem; Purpose; Questions; Collection; Codes; Themes_ChIV; Conclusions_ChV
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks the summary still plans rather than reports.

how_to_notes.heading: References
how_to_notes.purpose: Keep seminal vs build-on vs software vs new-instrument vs audit-artifact classes intact.
how_to_notes.do: Match docs/notion/templates/references.csv origin and citation_status columns.
how_to_notes.do_not: Do not use Guest et al. (2006) as the interview method or Delve as a literature source for analysis.
how_to_notes.tester_check: Tester checks What We Know citations are used only for allowed purposes.
